Ava: Heads-up Slack thread: CloudWave contacted us about launching in APAC-North2 (new region). They can commit hardware but need marketplace entitlements + a soft quota approval.
Diego: Do we have their SKU list and expected monthly baseline?
Ava: CloudWave SKUs: CW-A100-40GB, CW-A30-80GB, CW-T4x. Baseline: 8 x A100-40GB, 3 x A30-80GB, 16 x T4. Burst plan to 20/6/40 respectively.
Rina: Legal notes: marketplace entitlements require our publisher manifest + partner ROLLOUT clause. Need partner to sign the marketplace addendum by 2026-04-22 to hit their announcement slot.
Marcus: I'll own the quota ticket and smoke canary. Can we ask partner to validate SKUs with this command?
```
cloudctl skus list --region apac-north2 --filter "CW-A100-40GB" --json
```
Ava: I'll send the entitlement form link and ping their AM. Contact is mai@cloudwave.example. I'll cc legal and marketing.
partner-bot: Reminder: entitlement form submitted? https://partners.cloudwave/entitlement. Auto-reminder in 36h.
Diego: Product asks: perf targets (p50 < 140ms, p95 < 320ms), rolling canary over 48h, and a small eval set for marketplace QA. Who owns eval?
Rina: I'll prepare a minimal eval prompt set and the addendum draft.
Marcus: Ticket CREATED: CLOUD-79221. Requested GPUs: 14 (prod+buffer). vCPU estimate: 1.4k. Assigned to quotas-team.
Ava: Announcement target proposed 2026-05-06. Legal signoff needed by 2026-04-22.
Diego: Ownership: Marcus = quota & canary, Rina = legal & QA prompts, Ava = partner comms & PR timeline, Diego = product rollout gating.
Ava: OK team I'll update when CloudWave confirms entitlement submission. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
